new.n: Wealthy St. bank robbery loot cache, woods a mile outside Smyrna
new.pl: Smyrna (Ionia Co.); the cache was "in the woods a mile outside Smyrna", direction not given (about 1.6 km radius)
new.v: Several thousand dollars of a $6,000 bank haul, unrecovered
new.st: On 24 May 1932 a gang of four robbed the Wealthy Street branch of the Grand Rapids Savings Bank of $6,000; Deputy Sheriff Charles Knapp of Lowell was killed in the getaway and the gang was run down near Ionia. Directions in a notebook found on Henry "Baldy" Marshall led officers to a cache in the woods a mile outside Smyrna, where part of the loot was recovered. In July 1935 Marshall, serving life, said he knew "where the rest of it is hidden" (several thousand dollars) and tried to trade it for parole; the offer was refused and no spot was named. The pin marks Smyrna, not the cache.
new.t: The rest may be near the Smyrna cache or elsewhere. Check wooded tracts within about 1.6 km of Smyrna on the 1938 aerial. Private land: ask permission first.
src: Grand Rapids Press, 26 May 1932, p. 1, "More Loot Recovered" (newspapers.com 1112681010)
Monroe Evening News, 9 Jul 1935, p. 12 (newspapers.com 1280240615); Kalamazoo Gazette, 10 Jul 1935, p. 1
pinev: Town of Smyrna; cache only described as a mile outside town, direction not given
